# One vendor per region, exceptions by explicit approval

## Decision Question

Should a region ever run two billing vendors at once?

## Decision Outcome

No. One vendor per region is the default. A second vendor in the same region requires named approval from the engagement lead, recorded before contracting.

## Alternatives Considered

- Allow two vendors wherever contracts already commit to it. Rejected: that is the state the last rollout was trying to exit.
- Defer the rule until after the EMEA contract renewal. Rejected: the renewal is the decision that most needs the rule.

## Approved By

Priya Raghavan, engagement lead.

## Context

The prior rollout ran two vendors in EMEA and spent most of nine months reconciling them.
